lib/widgets/heroes/dot_hero.dart:12:/// Dot visualisation embedded in the Void hero slot: a single pulsing circle whose radius tracks the spectrum's bass energy (Void chrome owns transport). When [DotScreenConfig.showSongInfo] is true (B-020) the active track's Artist (H1) / Song (H2) overlay the top of the band in a [Stack] above the centered dot, using the shared [HeroTitleBlock] (B-046).
